name: Kiku no Hana
source:
Visual novel set in the Heian Period (794-1185). A prince is born without speech and is raised by a maid with secret medical knowledge. Over the years, they face social, emotional and political challenges together. As the empire doubts his ability, the prince learns to communicate in other ways. His journey will lead him to decide whether to lead in silence... or lose everything.
